items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I didn't know King Oliver, I didn't know Buddy Bowling.

ctx.x: He played a piano with a robot show. Yeah, them kind of people like Udall and all them, I remember them, but all them people they asked me about, I really don't know them, I did not know them. I didn't know King Oliver, I didn't know Buddy Bowling.
You didn't know King Oliver even in Chicago?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Of all the men's I wanted to see was one Buddy Bowden I never did see him

ctx.x: Oh yeah but you never knew him to play or No You didn't know him at the other time I see Yeah
Of all the men's I wanted to see was one Buddy Bowden I never did see him
Who are some of the older ones?
Well, I didn't know nobody but King Oliver and Bunk Johnson. I never met Buddy Bowling.
Edward Clem, did you meet him?
